structured.answer: I'd check my קרן השתלמות from work, and look into opening a חשבון ניירות ערך at my bank to buy something that tracks the S&P 500. I'm only fairly sure, because the page explains what things are but never says what to pick or what it costs.

stuck.why: 13 cards that all look alike (index after index). Too many to choose from, and nothing marks one as recommended
The heading sits there alone and its cards only come on the next screen, so for a moment I didn't know what it belonged to
Sounded like a pension thing for older people so I passed it, though the card says 'אפשר למשוך בכל עת'. I'm not sure what it really is

used: Heading 'מדריך' and subline 'כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה'
'שני חלקים בכל חיסכון': first lines 'איפה הכסף מוחזק' / 'במה הכסף מושקע'
'מאיפה להתחיל': 'שכירים שהמעסיק מפקיד להם: קרן השתלמות'
skimmed: כסף שוטף וקצר cards (עו"ש, פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון)
קרן השתלמות / קופת גמל בניהול אישי
מזומן שקלי, קרן כספית, מק"מ, איגרות חוב ממשלתיות, מסלול כללי
MSCI World, MSCI AC World, נאסד"ק 100
skipped: Footer links and the grey line at the bottom
Small grey line 'בכל עמוד של מוצר יש שורה...'
unsure_meaning: קופת גמל להשקעה vs קרן השתלמות difference
not_found: Any fee amounts, in percent or in shekels
Any recommendation or 'start here' for someone with 30,000 ₪ to invest
What return to expect from any option
Which bank or company to use

findings.what: No numbers at all (fees, returns, amounts), so I can't tell what is worth it or what costs a lot
'מאיפה להתחיל' covers employees, pensions and short-term money, but not 'I have savings and want them to grow'
Too many look-alike index cards with no hint which one to choose
Jargon in the card text (מק"מ, חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת, מסלול כללי) with no plain explanation
The 'לבחירה עצמית' heading is cut off from its cards at the screen break
findings.where: Bottom of screen 1 / top of screen 2

findings.what: The S&P 500 card, the one I came for, sits at the far left of its row, easy to miss
